added: 74821: Workstation Agent now runs on macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon), installable interactively with the .pkg or shell installer or across a fleet with MDM.
fixed: 73177: Fixed an issue where dongle and process usage was not displayed because the offline monitoring and process-user features were missing from the feature allowlist.
improved: 57021: Agents no longer produce project-related notifications when the projects configuration is disabled in Agents Hub.
74349: On Linux and macOS, the Workstation Agent now minimizes an application window before suspending the process, matching the existing Windows behavior.

added: 69269: Workstation Agent now supports encrypted Client Authorization files, so sensitive credentials are no longer stored in plain text.
fixed: 63019: Fixed a Linux installer issue affecting Network Users.
70443: Fixed an issue where Workstation Agent stopped unexpectedly after a restart.
70635: Fixed an issue where the AutoCAD extension named pipe server failed to initialize on AutoCAD 2025 (.NET 8).
70639: Fixed an issue where TouchPointEvent.Enrich() overwrote the Workstation field with the UserName instead of the HostName.
71453: Fixed excessive log file growth on specific user terminals.
72154: Fixed an issue where Workstation Agent did not start automatically after an auto-upgrade.
updated: 69235: Updated the initial installer seed mechanism.
58109: Reworked the Workstation Agent monitoring sequence.
removed: 70516: Removed the AutoCAD plugin from the Platform Workstation Agent. The plugin now ships separately.
70517: Deleted the AutoCAD plugin projects and solution file from the Workstation Agent codebase.

added: 67510: OpenLM Platform Workstation Agent can now run either elevated or non-elevated based on the permissions.runAsElevated setting, showing a User Access Control (UAC) prompt only when enabled.
64672: Process Manager now supports command-line launch arguments and window title monitoring.
61308: Added an automatic mass update mechanism for Workstation Agent.
fixed: 68556: Fixed an issue where Workstation Agent process is terminated after an upgrade and fails to start again.
66546: Fixed an issue where the Installer did not show the Use Dongle Monitoring checkbox in Cloud mode.
66129: Fixed an error in Agents Hub that could show "Product not activated" when Dongle Monitoring is off.
65897: Fixed an issue where Workstation Agent did not pick up changes to a project environment variable after the initial read.

updated: 62604: Dongle Monitoring communication now uses WebSockets instead of HTTP.
fixed: 64994: Resolved an issue where dongle sessions were not recreated after a computer resumed from sleep.
improved: 65290: When installed under the SYSTEM account (e.g., via SCCM), Workstation Agent now automatically starts under the logged-in interactive user.
